info.description:
# Schemas and examples

You can download the following zipped archive, which contains XML schemas and examples of the request and response payloads for each of the API endpoints:

[Schemas and example messages](/api-documentation/docs/api/download/customs-inventory-linking-imports/2.0/inventory-linking-imports-schemas.zip) 

ZIP, 3.1MB last updated 17/09/2026
info.title: Customs Inventory Linking Imports

post.description: CSPs requesting to present their goods to Customs.

parameters.description: Specifies the version of the API that you want to call. See [versioning](https://developer.service.hmrc.gov.uk/api-documentation/assets/common/docs/versioning.md).
parameters.name: Accept

parameters.description: Specifies the format of the request body, which must be XML.
parameters.name: Content-Type

parameters.description: Represents the end-user who is interacting with the subscribed application. Must be 6 to 12 characters, consisting of any combination of numeric digits and/or upper-case letters.
parameters.name: X-Badge-Identifier

parameters.description: The EORI associated with the originating owner of the declaration. Must have a maximum length of 17 characters, consisting of any combination of numeric digits and/or letters.
parameters.name: X-Submitter-Identifier

<inv:inventoryLinkingImportsGoodsArrival xmlns:inv="http://gov.uk/customs/inventoryLinkingImport/v1">
	<!--ID of the declaration assigned by Customs, being a specific customs ID or a Movement Reference Number (MRN)-->
	<inv:entryNumber>19GB9QWJDL941FGVR9</inv:entryNumber>
	<!-- Version number of the declaration before processing the amendment -->
	<inv:entryVersionNumber>2</inv:entryVersionNumber>
	<!-- Inventory Consignment Reference number which matches that within the declaration payload MUCR -->
	<inv:inventoryConsignmentReference>GB/1234-:3333HB</inv:inventoryConsignmentReference>
</inv:inventoryLinkingImportsGoodsArrival>

post.description: This validate movement response message is provided by the CSP as a result of a previous validate movement request. It represents the (positive/negative) outcome of matching a declaration Id (MRN) against the provided Inventory Consignment Reference (ICR)

parameters.description: Specifies the version of the API that you want to call. See [versioning](https://developer.service.hmrc.gov.uk/api-documentation/assets/common/docs/versioning.md).
parameters.name: Accept

parameters.description: Specifies the format of the request body. Must be "application/xml; charset=UTF-8" or the request will be rejected with HTTP status code 415.
parameters.name: Content-Type

parameters.description: Represents the end-user who is interacting with the subscribed application. Must be 6 to 12 characters, consisting of any combination of numeric digits and/or upper-case letters.
parameters.name: X-Badge-Identifier

parameters.description: The EORI associated with the originating owner of the declaration. Must have a maximum length of 17 characters, consisting of any combination of numeric digits and/or letters.
parameters.name: X-Submitter-Identifier

parameters.description: Alpha-numeric, maximum length is 36. Specifies the correlation id sent in the movement validation request. Returning the request correlation id in the movement validation response permits backend reconciliation of request and response.
parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID

objectExample.value:
<inv:InventoryLinkingImportsValidateMovementResponse xmlns:inv="http://gov.uk/customs/inventoryLinkingImport/v1">
	<!--ID of the declaration assigned by Customs, being a specific customs ID or a Movement Reference Number (MRN)-->
	<inv:entryNumber>19GB9QRSR372ZFGVR4</inv:entryNumber>
	<!--Version number of the declaration before processing the amendment -->
	<inv:entryVersionNumber>1</inv:entryVersionNumber>
	<!--Inventory Consignment Reference number which matches that within the declaration payload MUCR-->
	<inv:inventoryConsignmentReference>GB/1234-:3333HB</inv:inventoryConsignmentReference>
	<!--001 indicates that the consignment has been mis-matched to the declaration which should cause CDS to stop processing the declaration further. -->
	<inv:irc>001</inv:irc>
</inv:InventoryLinkingImportsValidateMovementResponse>
